tasks.instruction: Wykorzystujac slowa podane wielkimi literami, uzupelnij luki w zdaniach tak, aby zachowac sens zdania wyjsciowego. W kazda luke mozesz wpisac do 6 wyrazow lacznie z wyrazem podanym. Nie wolno zmieniac form podanych slow. Niedopuszczalne sa formy skrocone (isn't, won't, would've itd.). Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc gramatyczna i ortograficzna.

items.original: Nobody can do all that work in one single day. It's impossible.
items.transformed: Nobody _________ all that work in one single day.

items.original: I wish I hadn't eaten so much cake.
Did the teacher give you the handout yesterday?
items.transformed: Did the teacher _________ the handout yesterday?

items.original: I'm not interested in what you think about me.
I can't afford to buy a new house.
items.answer: do not have enough money to

items.original: The concert hall is close to the hotel, so we can walk there.
items.transformed: The concert hall is close to the hotel, so we can _________.
items.answer: go there on foot / get there on foot

items.original: She is not interested in sports.
The podcast was too boring for me to finish.
items.answer: so boring that I could not / so boring that I did not

items.original: He didn't understand the instructions, so he made a mistake.
items.transformed: _________, he wouldn't have made a mistake.
items.answer: If he had understood the instructions

items.original: After the show, they introduced us to the leading actor.
items.transformed: After the show, _________ to the leading actor.
